method: All samples retained; nearest-rank p50/p95/p99. CPU fresh/same grouping is deterministic n modulo3, not filtering. Cold first real sample retained in all-real and separately reported. Second-through-last real samples are not assumed cache-warm. No performance thresholds imply acceptance. Cumulative true Canvas misses are rasterizations minus cache hits for the frozen original raster path; raw cacheGetMisses are separately preserved, not per-frame attribution. Resource endpoints include prep/warm/real. GPU layout/calls/bytes may change and are reported without equality requirement. Complete uploader candidate must match exact ordered patch manifest. Only 512-square scratch ownership/selection/accounting is intended to change; static review and native proof validate that scope separately. Different per-slot histories may change cold/partial/unchanged upload calls and ROI bytes; these are reported, not equality-gated. Added CPU/GPU scratch ownership must be included in total/peak accounting; no inference of reduced traffic from source view length. Raw facts are retained and checked separately from hashes. Legacy capture lacking optimized bundle snapshots fails strict provenance rather than inventing validation. Real n480..491 follows identical archived fixture, not per-frame raw clock telemetry. Percentiles with 48 real samples per policy have limited tail stability.
